policy.objective: Choose the least costly available model and effort that can satisfy each closed work-unit contract accurately.
policy.manualSelectionReason: The V14 router being implemented cannot select its own bootstrap team.

assignments.rationale: The public deterministic compiler, strict schemas, global vector search, and security boundaries have high semantic complexity and blast radius.
The work is a bounded documentation and configuration surface with explicit source contracts and no kernel code.
Independent adversarial test design needs strong reasoning, but its disjoint fixture and test scope does not require the frontier compiler model.
The dependent release review spans correctness, compatibility, security, host truthfulness, and all producer outputs.
